title: SegmentationWorkerV1
description: Any message of the internal HTTP contract between the API's job handlers and the segmentation worker (workers/ml/segmentation); not part of the public OpenAPI. `POST /v1/segment` takes a SegmentRequest and returns a SegmentResponse; `GET /health` returns a HealthResponse. Field names are snake_case on the wire. Additive-only within v1 (planning/06 §4); a breaking change ships as segmentation.v2.json next to this file. The worker never receives image bytes or user data, only R2 object references (planning/04 §2).

MaskLabel.description: Label of a segmentation mask. The six garment values (top, bottom, dress, outerwear, shoes, accessory) are owned by the `closet` taxonomy (docs/modules/closet.md) and restated here until the closet taxonomy registry (P06-T01) exists; then they come from it. `background` is segmentation-only (pixels that belong to no garment) and is not a taxonomy class.

SegmentRequest.description: Body of `POST /v1/segment`: segment one garment photo already stored in R2. An object reference only, never image bytes or user data. `hint` is an optional garment class hint from the closet taxonomy.

image_ref.description: R2 object key of the source image

Provenance.description: Honesty marker: every generated view carries provenance and confidence.

generated.description: True: the result was produced by a model

model.description: Identifier of the model that produced the result

MaskRef.description: A derived mask stored back to R2 (never inline pixels).

mask_ref.description: R2 object key of the mask

SegmentResponse.description: Reply of `POST /v1/segment`: mask references for the requested image, plus the provenance and confidence marker.
